verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a local, open-source image-processing CLI and library. It holds no user account or hosted data, so 'export all of my data and leave' (data portability and lock-in) is a category error for this kind of product. Its support for converting images between 200+ formats is an image-transformation feature, not a data-export or exit capability, so it is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
